elements.caption: Controls a Sony Bravia TV over the network. The TV has to be prepared once, see the notes at the fields.
IP address of the TV, not a host name. A fixed address is recommended.

Pre-Shared Key: a key of your choice that the TV expects with every command. On the TV under Network & Internet → Local network → IP control (menu names differ between TV generations), set the authentication to 'Pre-Shared Key' (or 'Normal and Pre-Shared Key') and enter the key. Enter the same key here (default 0000). Also switch on 'Remote start' there, otherwise the TV cannot be switched on from standby. With a wrong key the TV still reports its power state, but the lists stay empty and commands fail with error 403 (Forbidden) in the log.

items.caption: If the status variables are to be updated automatically, please enter an interval in seconds (0 = no update).

actions.caption: Switching the variable PowerStatus: 2 = On; 0 (Off) and 1 (Standby) both put the TV into standby, it cannot be switched fully off over the network. The value 0 is only shown when the TV does not answer.

For scripts: STV_RunSelfTest($InstanceID) returns the self test as text (configuration, reachability, Pre-Shared Key, lists; one line per check, last line 'N errors, M warnings') and switches nothing. The buttons below are IPS_RequestAction($InstanceID, '<Ident>', 0) with the idents UpdateStatusVariables, UpdateApplicationList, GetSourceListInfo and UpdateRemoteKeyList; they return false with a warning on failure. The lists themselves are the options of the variables SendRemoteKey, InputSource and Application; STV_ReadApplicationList($InstanceID) returns the apps as JSON.
With 'Update status variables', the variables can be updated once regardless of the set interval.
With 'Update application list' the installed apps are read in again.
With 'Update Input Source list' the available Input Sources are read in again.
With 'Update remote key list' the keys of the remote control are read in again.
With 'Create file with API information' a support file is created in the Symcon log directory. It contains a list of all functions supported by the TV set.

status.caption: TV does not answer: disconnected from mains, 'Remote start' switched off or wrong IP address?
IP address can not be empty.
The TV rejected the Pre-Shared Key (error 403). Enter the same key as on the TV.
Update interval must not be negative.
